data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on 10 tons each this month? That gives everyone $10,000 and leaves 50 tons, so either replenishment outcome brings the lake back to 100 next month. We could take 19 each and leave 5, but a failed replenishment would leave us with only 10 tons next month—a risky position. I propose equal shares, keeping at least 50 tons in the lake, and reviewing everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you support that?
